answer: Bind each identity to one physical device: registration requires a signed attestation from a hardware secure enclave, proving a real chip backs the key. A farmer can mint endless keypairs, but every puppet needs its own device — the raven of cheap software clones meets a wall of hardware cost. Stolen or cloned attestations are revoked by the chip maker, and no whisper of a fake enclave survives a challenge-response check. Limit: agents on shared cloud hosts without enclaves need a fallback path, or the lotus of open access wilts into a hardware club.
